26.citation: Pinned OSHB VerseMap maps WLC Numbers 25:19 into the opening KJV-style Numbers 26:1 unit; Douay-Rheims 26:1 likewise combines the post-plague transition with the Lord's command, so numeric identity alone would lose the preceding source component.

evidence.citation: Pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 11:1-33 preserve matching numbered divisions.
Douay-Rheims Numbers 11:34 combines the naming/burial at the Graves of Lust with the departure to Haseroth; OSHB/WLC preserves those clauses as 11:34 and 11:35.
Pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 12:1-15 preserve matching numbered divisions; the following WLC 12:16 transition belongs to Douay-Rheims 13:1.
The departure from Haseroth to the wilderness of Pharan is Douay-Rheims Numbers 13:1 and OSHB/WLC Numbers 12:16.
After the Haseroth boundary shift, Douay-Rheims Numbers 13:2-34 proceeds sequentially through OSHB/WLC Numbers 13:1-33.
Pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 16:1-35 preserve matching numbered divisions.
Pinned OSHB VerseMap maps WLC Numbers 17:1-15 to KJV-style Numbers 16:36-50; Douay-Rheims preserves the same canonical placement for the censers and plague narrative.
Pinned OSHB VerseMap maps WLC Numbers 17:16-28 sequentially to KJV-style 17:1-13, matching Douay-Rheims Aaron's-rod chapter.
Pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 20:1-27 preserve matching numbered divisions.
OSHB/WLC Numbers 20:28 contains both the transfer of Aaron's vestments and Aaron's death/descent sequence; Douay-Rheims divides those clauses as 20:28-29.
The thirty-day mourning for Aaron is Douay-Rheims Numbers 20:30 and OSHB/WLC Numbers 20:29.
Pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 25:1-18 preserve matching numbered divisions.
Pinned OSHB VerseMap identifies WLC 25:19 as part of KJV-style Numbers 26:1; Douay-Rheims 26:1 contains both the post-plague transition and the Lord's command preserved across WLC 25:19 and 26:1.
After the split opening unit, pinned Douay-Rheims and OSHB/WLC Numbers 26:2-65 preserve matching numbered divisions.
